semiconductor_relevance: High — Sai MicroElectronics Inc. is a leading MEMS pure-play foundry and specialty semiconductor wafer manufacturer with independent intellectual property rights.
summary: Sai MicroElectronics Inc. (SMEI) specializes in MEMS chip manufacturing and offers a range of semiconductor wafer services. The company supports various applications including silicon photonics, LiDAR, and AI computing, catering to a diverse clientele across multiple industries.

regional_presence.China: SMEI operates as a specialty semiconductor wafer manufacturer in China with a global footprint.
